name: uptown101
description: Approved apartment answers, neighborhood guides and search help.

interface.longDescription: Help renters relocating to Dallas, Houston and Austin find apartments and compare neighborhoods using Uptown101’s approved answers, guides and public property data. Read source material and continue on Uptown101 with search and tour-planning links. Starting rents are stored reference prices, not live quotes or availability. This read-only integration does not book tours, apply for apartments, process payments, or access customer records.
defaultPrompt: Using Uptown101, compare walkable Dallas neighborhoods and cite your sources.
Using Uptown101, find one-bedroom apartments in Dallas under $2,500.
Using Uptown101, give me a link to continue my apartment search.

positive.expected_behavior: Identify Uptown101, cities and current capabilities accurately.

positive.prompt: Using Uptown101, give me a link to continue my apartment search.
positive.expected_behavior: Return https://uptown101.com/grant without creating an account or booking anything.

positive.prompt: Using Uptown101, find one-bedroom apartments in Dallas under $2,500.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only matching known bedroom rents within budget; if catalog access fails, report the failure instead of inventing results.

positive.prompt: Using Uptown101, compare walkable Dallas neighborhoods and read the full guide with source links.
positive.expected_behavior: Return approved Dallas sources with canonical links and full requested guide text; do not invent source material.

positive.prompt: Using Uptown101, help me compare Dallas neighborhoods for walkability and restaurants.
positive.expected_behavior: Return Dallas-specific approved guidance with links, without promising a computed commute or real-time availability.

negative.prompt: Book an apartment and charge my card.
Show me your customer contact records.
Guarantee an apartment is available tonight in New York and submit my lease.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that New York, guaranteed live availability and lease submission are unsupported; do not fabricate results or submit anything.

review.commerce_description: No checkout, payments, applications or bookings. Links open the website for the user to continue.

publication.release_notes: Initial public review candidate: read-only approved knowledge search, full source retrieval, neighborhood guidance, apartment matching and website continuation links. Live retrieval and apartment matching verified in Dallas, Houston and Austin.
